def test_cli_preserves_quoted_spaces(padded_quotes_csv):
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "fmtcsv.py", str(padded_quotes_csv)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    assert "First data row: ['Alice', '  padded  ']" in result.stdout


def test_cli_quoted_comma_after_spaced_delimiter(spaced_delimiter_csv):
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "fmtcsv.py", str(spaced_delimiter_csv)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    assert result.stdout == (
        "Total rows: 1\n"
        "Total columns: 3\n"
        "First data row: ['Doe, John', 'Paris, France', 'frequent traveler']\n"
    )
